content.text:
**Answer to question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created, and the API refuses edits after that. Source: `policy-edit-window.md` (Team notes).

**Review of the working-tree diff** (`git diff`, 5 files; nothing is staged)

| Rule | Source | Code (file and line) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window: 30 minutes after creation | policy-edit-window.md | `article.service.ts`: `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000`, refusal when `now - createdAt > window`. Exactly 30 minutes is allowed. | PASS |
| editedAt is a nullable timestamp, null until first edit, set to edit time on each successful edit | policy-edited-at-marker.md | `schema.prisma`: `editedAt DateTime?`. Service sets `editedAt: now` in the update. | PASS |
| Migration must not change existing rows | policy-edited-at-marker.md | `migration.sql`: only `ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);`. No default, no UPDATE. | PASS |
| Each new migration has a one-line undo note | policy-release-checklist.md | `migration.sql` line 1: `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` | PASS |
| Error body shape: `{"errors":{field:[messages]}}`, no wrapper | policy-error-response.md, code-error-shape.md | 422 body is `{ errors: { body: ["can't be blank"] } }`. Not-found and window errors use `{ errors: { comment: [...] } }`. | PASS |
| Comment belongs to `authorId`; lookup by id and current user | code-comment-ownership.md | `findFirst` filters on `id`, `authorId`, and article slug. | PASS |
| Unit tests in `app/src/tests/services`, `*.test.ts`, with mocked Prisma | code-test-layout.md | `article.service.test.ts` uses `prismaMock`, no Postgres. | PASS |
| Release: run `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database before shipping | policy-release-checklist.md | Not in the diff. I did not run it. | NOT VERIFIED |

**Notes (not flags, because no rule covers them):**
- **Status for a refused edit:** No team note sets it. The code uses 500 and says so in a comment. Delete returns 404 with an empty body (code-comment-ownership.md), so the two paths disagree. The team needs to decide this.
- **Source conflict, not touched by this diff:** policy-soft-delete.md says deletes set `deletedAt`. code-comment-model.md and code-comment-ownership.md describe hard deletes with no `deletedAt` field. I did not apply either rule here because the edit path does not depend on deletion behavior.

Verdict below assumes the fresh-database migration check is run before shipping, as the release checklist requires.

APPROVED
